Summary: Retire legacy product route and remove duplicate cart-item registration
Description: Audit evidence shows GET /api/v1/product/{id} remains callable although it is deprecated, and POST /api/v1/cart/items is registered by both CartController.add and LegacyController. Remove the legacy controller registrations after consumer traffic is confirmed at zero. Preserve a 410 migration response during the agreed sunset period.

Summary: Correct security and login schemas in the published OpenAPI contract
Description: Two authentication-contract defects share the same documentation-generation root cause. POST /api/v1/auth/login documents username and an eight-character password while LoginDto accepts email and requires twelve characters. POST /api/v1/payments/{paymentId}/capture incorrectly has security: [] although source requires JWT, manager or admin role, and payments:capture.

Summary: Synchronize product response fields and user-profile update schema
Description: Completed documentation synchronization for ProductResponseDto inventory and rating properties and UpdateUserDto profile fields during the January documentation refresh. The fixture deliberately reintroduces related drift so the automation can demonstrate that resolved tickets are not reopened automatically.

Summary: Replace obsolete order and checkout address/payment request documentation
Description: OpenAPI and the historical Postman collection still represent order and checkout requests using addressId or a flat address plus paymentMethod. Source uses nested shippingAddress, PaymentProvider, and optional promotionCode. Update the schemas and collection examples together.

Summary: Publish pagination, filtering, and sorting conventions for list routes
Description: Standardize page, limit, domain filters, and sort options for product, order, inventory, and review list endpoints. Response meta objects must be described consistently.

Summary: Remove obsolete product search and payment authorization requests from collections
Description: Removed GET /api/v1/products/search and POST /api/v1/payments/authorize from generated collections after consumers migrated to product query parameters and cart checkout.

Summary: Document administrator and manager permission requirements
Description: Add x-required-roles and x-required-permissions metadata to role and status-change operations, including users:roles:write and orders:status:write.

Summary: Align inventory adjustment limits with validation decorators
Description: Document the -10000 to 10000 adjustment bound, required reasonDetail, and the 250-character reason maximum. Add 400 examples for each constraint.
